Unofficial **practice notes** for the [Spring Boot Full Course](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEYgx5hMdopw) playlist.  
These pages are written so anyone can **type code in their own editor**, one step at a time — not just rewatch the video.

| | |
|--|--|
| **Series** | Spring Boot & Spring Framework (Full Course) |
| **Instructor** | Aditya Tandon (Coder Army) |
| **Playlist** | [YouTube — Spring Boot Full Course](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEYgx5hMdopw) |
| **How to use** | Watch a short section → pause → implement the practice steps here → only then continue |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Study pattern (recommended)

1. Skim the **Goal** and **Concepts** on this site.
2. Open your IDE (IntelliJ / VS Code / Eclipse).
3. Follow **Practice** steps *without* copying whole projects blindly — type them.
4. Attempt **Exercises** before opening self-check answers.
5. Replay the video only when stuck on *why*, not on *what to type*.
:::

## Prerequisites

- Comfortable with Java basics (classes, interfaces, constructors, packages)
- JDK 17+ installed (`java -version`)
- An IDE (IntelliJ IDEA Community is what the series uses)
